verdict.rationale: SerpApi's Google Search API docs say the query can include any regular Google search operator, including `site:`, so restricting results to a domain is documented. This works by passing Google's operators through the query string rather than through a dedicated domain-filter control. Excluding domains (e.g. `-site:`) is only implied, not stated. missing for 10: a dedicated include/exclude-domains parameter, explicit documentation of domain exclusion, coverage beyond Google Search, independent or hands-on corroboration.
